runs.note: The focused module HUNG and was killed at the 120s tool bound. Cause found and fixed: `_bounded_read` opened entries with os.open(O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW), and opening a FIFO for reading BLOCKS until a writer appears -- so the fifo case never returned. O_NONBLOCK now makes the open return so the descriptor can be refused for what it is. CHARGED AT THE TOOL BOUND, WHICH IS AN ESTIMATE AND NOT A PROVEN UPPER BOUND: per owner M166281 and review claim166235, a tool bound records when observation stopped, not when the process tree ended.
